title: Where is my phone again?
objectives: ask and answer where personal items are located
use prepositions of place (in, on, under, next to, behind)

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Where is my phone again?.
Welcome to today's lesson: Where is my phone again?! Today we will practice how to ask and answer where personal items are located.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for Where is my phone again?:
ask and answer where personal items are located; use prepositions of place (in, on, under, next to, behind)

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: in, on, under, behind, window, door

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Where are the keys in the reading text?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: Where is my phone? Oh, it is in your bag next to the door!

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
Where is my phone? It is on the table next to the window. The keys are under the chair near the door.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Ask your partner where three personal items in the room are located.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.
